title: America's Great Divide: Steve Bannon (first interview) | FRONTLINE
summary: The full, long-form FRONTLINE interview with Steve Bannon, recorded in 2019 for the documentary series on the Obama-to-Trump era. He discusses his populist politics, the Trump campaign and White House, and his view of the establishment.
why: HN people recommend it as an unfiltered way to understand Bannon's worldview and the populist movement, and praise PBS for releasing full interviews.

quote.text: this is worth at least an hour of your time
